# Accessibility / WCAG

- Prefer native semantic elements before ARIA.
- Ensure all interactive elements work with keyboard input.
- Provide visible focus indicators.
- Associate form controls with labels.
- Provide useful alternative text for meaningful images.
- Do not rely on color alone to communicate state.
- Manage focus when dialogs open/close.
- Use ARIA only when native semantics are insufficient.
